info.title: ProcessMind External API
info.description:
REST API for integrating ProcessMind process mining and simulation into your own systems.

Authentication: every request must send an API key in the `x-api-key` header. Keys are created in the ProcessMind app (Admin Settings → API Keys). Organization write endpoints additionally require an organization-scoped API key.

The base URL is `https://api.processmind.com` (stage-specific URLs may differ).

InternalError.description: Unexpected server error: the request can be retried safely

Conflict.description: The request conflicts with the current state (e.g. a seat gate or a reused id)

NotAcceptable.description: The value cannot be accepted (e.g. a reserved or duplicate short name)

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limited: see the endpoint's documented rate limit

ServiceUnavailable.description: Data pipeline not ready or an upstream query failed

PayloadTooLarge.description: File exceeds the platform's maximum upload size

post.summary: Mint a one-time login handoff token for a user
post.description: Returns a single-use token (60s TTL) bound to the user, tenant and organization, plus the `url` to send the user's browser to. Open the URL in the user's browser and they land in ProcessMind already authenticated: no email link, no impersonation; the user gets their own session. Requires the dedicated `sessions` scope on the API key: an **organization-scoped** key may mint for any tenant of its organization, a **tenant-scoped** key only for users of its own tenant. Treat the token as password-equivalent: it is returned once, never logged, and revoked by disabling the key or the user.

get.summary: Get per-case metrics of a process (latest model, paged)
get.description: Returns one row per case with the computed process metrics (case duration, length, conformance, rework, health score, variant, and more) for the process's latest model. No row filtering is applied. The result is paged: use `limit` (default 1000, max 10000) and `offset`, and keep paging while `hasMore` is true. While the metrics are still being computed, the response has state `preprocessing`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of case rows to return (default 1000, max 10000)

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Number of case rows to skip (default 0)

The {tenantId} path parameter is the context tenant (the organization of the organization-scoped key), not the target of the operation.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a tenant in the organization (requires an organization-scoped API key)
delete.description: API access for the tenant stops immediately. The tenant and its data are kept during the deletion-safety window and are removed by the automated full delete afterwards. The tenant you are currently using (the context tenant) cannot be deleted.

post.summary: Restore a soft-deleted tenant in the organization (requires an organization-scoped API key)
post.description: Undo a soft delete inside the deletion-safety window: the tenant and its data come back exactly as they were and API access resumes. The {tenantId} path parameter is the context tenant (the organization of the organization-scoped key), not the target of the operation.

get.summary: Get the organization's seat capacity and auto-sync policy
get.description: Returns the org-wide purchased vs in-use seats per rung (Process Foundation, Process Architecture, Process Intelligence), the free-viewer allowance, the auto-sync target, the seat-drift explainer (what the engine will do and when), the billing interval and the externalApiSeatPolicy. Readable with a tenant-scoped API key. The {tenantId} path parameter is the context tenant (the organization of the organization-scoped key), not the target of the operation.

post.summary: Model Context Protocol server endpoint (JSON-RPC over Streamable HTTP)
post.description: JSON-RPC 2.0 over Streamable HTTP: `initialize`, `tools/list`, `tools/call`, `resources/list`, `resources/read`, `prompts/list`. Read tools require the key's `read` scope, write tools the `write` scope. The tool catalogue is documented in the MCP guide. Authenticate with `x-api-key` or `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (token from the OAuth token endpoint).
